lines.3: Otome and Konoe were chatting happily.
lines.4: 「There's the Konoe you hate. You've really been running into her a lot lately.」
lines.5: 「I'm going to hide behind you and slip past.」
lines.6: 「You don't have to sneak around that much.」
lines.7: 「I value my peace of mind! Protect me properly, Subaru.」
lines.11: 「You don't need to get that fired up.」
lines.12: Anyway, I moved along while hiding behind Subaru.
lines.16: Good. I was going to make it through safely.
lines.19: I immediately put an index finger to my lips in a 'Shh!' gesture.
lines.23: 「Hmph... What are you sneaking around for? You look pathetic.」
lines.24: 「Shut up. This is exactly why I didn't want to run into you.」
lines.25: 「And every bit of it is your own fault.」
lines.27: 「Hmph. Go rot for all I care.」
lines.28: 「...This is awfully hostile. What am I supposed to do about it?」
lines.29: 「What's with this guy? Is he picking a fight!?」
lines.30: 「Impressive that you can say that in this atmosphere.」
lines.31: 「She can't read the room, after all.」
lines.32: It turned into a lousy afternoon.
